name: Royalty, licence or intangible-asset payments concentrated in a low-tax affiliate with minimal functions
description: Recurring payments for brands, software or intellectual property go to a related entity in a low-tax jurisdiction that has little staff, development activity or control over the asset.
fp: Many groups hold intellectual property in a central entity for legitimate commercial reasons, and rates may be supported by a formal transfer-pricing study.

links.name: Royalty, licence or intangible-asset payments concentrated in a low-tax affiliate with minimal functions
links.ctx: Operating companies pay a percentage of revenue as royalties to a group entity in a low-tax jurisdiction that holds the asset but has no development team.
